display_information.name: Humagen
display_information.description: Mention @Humagen in any channel, thread or DM. It brings in the right agents and answers where you asked.
display_information.long_description:
Humagen puts your workspace's agents in Slack. Mention @Humagen in a channel, a thread or a direct message. It brings in the agents that fit the question and answers in the thread where you asked.

Answers stream in as the agents work, and a Stop button ends a run early. Attach files, images or a voice clip and the agents read them. Use the "Ask about this" shortcut on any message to get an answer in that message's thread.

The Home tab shows what is waiting on you and what is new in your projects. Like or dislike an answer to say how it did.

shortcuts.name: Ask about this
shortcuts.description: Answers in this message's thread, with the message as the question.

agent_view.agent_description: Ask anything. Humagen brings in the right agents and answers here.
